newsitem.title: GERMANY: German firms seek to expand in U.S., not at home.
newsitem.headline: German firms seek to expand in U.S., not at home.

text.p: The U.S. tops the list of places German companies plan to expand their operations, followed by China and Britain, according to a survey released on Wednesday by RCN Marketing Consultants.
Only 17 percent of the companies that planned to expand planned to do so at home in Germany, while nearly 70 percent planned to expand in the U.S., the survey of 400 companies showed.
Most planned to venture abroad through joint ventures, cooperation tie-ups with existing firms, or acquisitions, while almost none planned greenfield investments, it said.
The German firms saw Southeast Asia as their main competitor, followed by the U.S. and Eastern Europe.
